page_title: No. 80 — Yemen Madalyası hakkında irade-i seniyye-i hususiye
grade_material_clues: 银质；与Yunan Muharebesi Madalyası同规格；正面御花押；背面Yemen Madalyası铭文；绿色绶带；佩戴顺序在希土战争奖章之后
notes: Printed page 302; PDF page 330; No. 80. The decree establishes the medal for officers, commanders and soldiers who rendered loyal service during the recent Yemen events.
